# Saudi Arabia dietary supplements and sports nutrition market, 2025-2026

Research lens for OptimalX (Salla store, Medina). Compiled 2026-09-17. Every number below carries a source URL and an access date. "Estimate" means a research-house projection or model; "measured" means a government statistic, an official disclosure, or a retailer's own published figure. Nothing here is a health claim.

Status: IN PROGRESS (written incrementally; sections marked (pending) are not yet researched)

## Size and growth

Headline: there is no single measured figure for the Saudi supplements market. Every market-size number below is a research-house estimate, and the houses disagree by a factor of roughly 1.5x on sports nutrition alone. Treat the range, not any single point, as the truth.

Sports nutrition (Saudi Arabia), all ESTIMATES:
- IMARC: USD 610.4 million in 2025, forecast USD 1,612.7 million by 2034, 11.40% CAGR 2026-2034. Source: https://www.imarcgroup.com/saudi-arabia-sports-nutrition-market (accessed 2026-09-17). IMARC segments by sports drinks / sports food / sports supplements and by channel (hypermarkets, convenience, drug and specialty stores, online, other); no segment shares published free.
- Grand View Research: USD 388.7 million revenue in 2025, forecast USD 716.6 million by 2033, about 8% CAGR 2026-2033. Source: https://www.grandviewresearch.com/horizon/outlook/sports-nutrition-market/saudi-arabia (accessed 2026-09-17 via search summary; page fetch pending verification).
- Euromonitor (free summary only): value sales rising in 2025; e-commerce is the fastest-growing channel; AmCan named as the leading company. Source: https://www.euromonitor.com/sports-nutrition-in-saudi-arabia/report (accessed 2026-09-17). No figures in the free summary.

Dietary supplements broadly (Saudi Arabia), all ESTIMATES:
- TechSci Research: USD 512.45 million in 2025, forecast USD 855.18 million by 2031, 8.91% CAGR. Source: https://www.techsciresearch.com/report/saudi-arabia-dietary-supplements-market/7563.html (accessed 2026-09-17 via search summary; verification pending).
- Grand View Research (GCC, not KSA alone): USD 1.72 billion in 2024, forecast USD 3.19 billion by 2030, 10.7% CAGR 2025-2030, Saudi Arabia "a significant share". Source: https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/gcc-dietary-supplements-market-report (accessed 2026-09-17).
- Mordor Intelligence: Saudi Arabia holds 17.13% of the Middle East and Africa dietary supplement market (2024), the largest single-country share. Source: https://www.mordorintelligence.com/industry-reports/middle-east-and-africa-dietary-supplement-market (accessed 2026-09-17).
- Statista Market Insights, Vitamins and Minerals (OTC segment only, narrow definition): figures are paywalled as of 2026-09-17 (page shows asterisks). A search snippet quoted USD 50.39 million for 2025 and 1.27% CAGR 2025-2030; treat as unverified. Source: https://www.statista.com/outlook/hmo/otc-pharmaceuticals/vitamins-minerals/saudi-arabia (accessed 2026-09-17).

Adjacent measured signals:
- E-commerce sales via mada cards reached about SAR 70 billion in Q1 2025 (highest ever, +56% year on year). Source: SPA, https://www.spa.gov.sa/en/N2351771 (accessed 2026-09-17). MEASURED (SAMA data via SPA).
- E-commerce via mada reached SAR 30.7 billion in October 2025 alone (+68% year on year). Source: Saudi Gazette, https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/657678 (accessed 2026-09-17). MEASURED (SAMA data).
- Fitness club market: IMARC estimates USD 1,260.4 million in 2025, USD 2,808.2 million by 2034, 9.31% CAGR. ESTIMATE. Source: https://www.imarcgroup.com/saudi-arabia-health-fitness-club-market (accessed 2026-09-17).

## Buyer profile

Measured activity base (GASTAT Physical Activity Statistics 2025, MEASURED):
- 59.1% of adults 18+ do 150+ minutes of physical activity per week; males 66.5%, females 43.1%; the 18-29 age band is highest at 71.2%. Source: https://www.stats.gov.sa/en/w/news/108 (accessed 2026-09-17); PDF: https://www.stats.gov.sa/documents/20117/2435273/Physical+Activity+Statistics+2025+EN+(1).pdf/e77cd712-0493-2422-2d8b-df53c9c641e0?t=1761197385484
- 2024 edition: 58.5% overall; non-Saudis 62.5% vs Saudis 54.1%; age 30-39 highest at 62.6% that year. Source: https://www.spa.gov.sa/en/N2216764 (accessed 2026-09-17).
- Caution: GASTAT's definition counts walking and work activity, so it is not a gym-goer count.

Supplement use surveys (academic, cross-sectional, self-selected samples; indicative not representative):
- Western Saudi Arabia (Dec 2023 to Feb 2024, n=1006): 70.5% reported dietary supplement use; sample was 71.8% female; 34.3% aged 18-30. Source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11990556/ (accessed 2026-09-17).
- Eastern Saudi Arabia physically active adults (2025, n=755): 66.9% used supplements; males 65.96%, females 67.82%. Source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12872503/ (accessed 2026-09-17).
- Active individuals nationwide (PLOS One): https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13286177/ (details pending).
